description: This file defines the ClientEntity class implementing OAuth2 client entity interface, encapsulating client details for OAuth authentication within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth client entity with attributes like identifier, name, redirect URI, confidentiality status, and display name. Implements the ClientEntityInterface for OAuth2 server integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ClientEntity with specified client details.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the client.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the client.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Indicates whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the client.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Creates a ClientEntity instance from an OAuthClient entity.
